source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed the dedicated Requirements Verification Matrix and V&V Plan appendices, Product Verification, Requirements/Configuration/Technical Data Management, Technical Assessment, requirement-quality guidance, NASA-HDBK-1009A, and NPR 7123.1B. Matrix names and method vocabularies are presented as organization-dependent while the trace, configuration, evidence, and authority principles remain explicit.

evidence: Reviewed typed trace graph nodes R,V,E,C,A,W,U and every named link relation.
Reviewed closure implication across applicability, atomicity, adequate planning, execution/configuration, supporting evidence, anomaly resolution, and approval.
Reviewed verification obligation coverage Gamma(r) and configuration-currency predicate Q(e,r,c).
Confirmed row/table views are projections rather than the conceptual source model.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently distinguishes requirements, obligations, activities, executions, evidence, configurations, anomalies, waivers, and authority.

evidence: Executed verification-matrix-integrity-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-080/report.json.
Confirmed four rows and IDs, four methods, three evidence pointers, three current configurations, and only two initial admissible closures.
Confirmed R-003 is stale and R-004 lacks evidence, yielding incomplete initial status.
Confirmed declared metadata corrections yield four admissible closures under the fixture's narrow rules.
Recomputed Exercise 2 missing requirement IDs as 240-238=2, unexplained row states as 245-(220+8+10)=7, naive pass 220/245=89.7959%, and current pass 215/245=87.7551%.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts demonstrate denominator and state problems only; they cannot establish semantic coverage, adequacy, evidence truth, or authorized compliance.

evidence: Confirmed row count does not entail requirement coverage because one requirement can have multiple obligations and requirements can be omitted.
Confirmed a passed execution does not entail closure without current baselines, resolved anomalies, limitations, and authority.
Confirmed child closure does not entail parent/system closure when allocation is incomplete or composition has emergent properties.
Confirmed one shared report does not entail each mapped criterion without explicit result mappings.
Confirmed automated structural validity does not entail engineering adequacy or evidence truth.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Closure logic is presented as necessary assurance gates rather than a universal proof that a matrix is semantically complete.

evidence: Challenged missing, duplicate, orphaned, filtered, not-applicable, split/merged, stale, contradictory, and manually overridden requirement rows.
Challenged wrong builds/articles/procedures/tools/data/environments, mutable/dead links, shared evidence, similarity reuse, and parent status copying.
Challenged modes, variants, interfaces, qualification versus production acceptance, human/data requirements, uncertainty, and adverse conditions.
Challenged failed/rerun history, anomalies, waivers, regression, authority, dashboard denominators, generated versus hand-edited snapshots, and migration loss.
Reviewed all ten worked examples and five complete answers for assumptions, reasoning, evidence limitations, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real matrix review requires relevant requirements, architecture, interface, verification/test, domain, configuration/data, safety/security, quality, supplier, operations, tool, and closure-authority expertise.

evidence: Confirmed authoritative baseline reconciliation and stable unique identity precede coverage claims.
Confirmed applicability/tailoring, criteria, method/level, activity, configuration, evidence, anomaly, and approval remain explicit.
Confirmed states and transitions distinguish plan, readiness, execution result, disposition, waiver, and closure.
Confirmed evidence is durable/provenanced and exact-baseline currency is checked on both requirement and product sides.
Confirmed bidirectional and negative-space audits detect orphan evidence, untraced failures, and missing obligations.
Confirmed change impact stales dependent closures while preserving prior snapshots/history.
invariant_checking.notes: No method letter, link, green cell, child roll-up, shared report, percentage, or automated check is treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal proof or theorem requires proof review; the module presents necessary closure gates, graph relations, arithmetic, and counterexamples.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled synthetic_metadata_only and complete_for_declared_metadata_rules.
Fixture limitations deny requirement completeness, method adequacy, evidence truth, equivalence, anomaly quality, authority, or actual compliance.
Examples and exercises are teaching cases, not project compliance matrices, certifications, acceptance decisions, or field evidence.
Official sources are attributed without claiming external NASA review or endorsement.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic structural checks, source-backed guidance, internal review, technical evidence, and authorized closure remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked VCRM terminology, typed trace model, vertical/horizontal trace, obligation granularity, applicability, criteria, methods/levels, executions, evidence, states, anomalies, waivers, hierarchical closure, audits, views, and change currency.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked source-of-truth governance, schema fields, planning/readiness, configuration binding, evidence pointers, similarity/reuse, automated integrity, semantic sampling, dashboards, spreadsheet/database/model implementation, migration, review snapshots, and lifecycle re-verification.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from authoritative requirement population through planning, execution, evidence, closure, audit, and migration. Ten examples and five complete solutions cover modes, shared reports, changes, interfaces, applicability, roll-up, qualification, reruns, filters, and generated models.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA expert, requirements owner, system architect, interface authority, verification organization, test/analysis specialist, configuration/data manager, safety/security reviewer, supplier, operator, tool vendor, certification/acceptance authority, or other external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
